description: Cartografía 1:1.000. Antena is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by idena.navarra.es. This layer contains the following map information at 1.1000 scale of the municipalities of Navarra: communication routes, constructions, hydrography, themed soil, altimetry, singular buildings, mapped area, infrastructure networks and other place names. The list of mapped municipalities is in the following url:. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Cartography 1:1,000. Antenna" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Transport networks, Utility and governmental services, Hidrografía, Dataset público con descarga disponible, Elevaciones, Redes de transporte. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
